places.name: Pangong Tso Lake
places.description: The most visually dramatic high-altitude lake in the world and an icon of Indian Himalayan travel.

places.name: Thiksey Monastery
places.description: Ladakh's most architecturally magnificent monastery, with a peerless Indus valley panorama at sunrise.
places.bestTime: May to September; 6 am for morning prayers

places.name: Nubra Valley
places.description: A surreal cold desert valley where Bactrian camels roam sand dunes beneath Himalayan glaciers.

places.name: Leh Palace
places.description: Ladakh's most iconic monument, with a commanding rooftop view over the ancient Leh capital.

places.name: Khardung La Pass
places.description: One of the world's highest motorable passes, an essential rite of passage for every Ladakh visitor.

places.name: Magnetic Hill
places.description: An intriguing roadside phenomenon set against a spectacular mountain-river landscape.

places.name: Hemis Monastery
places.description: Ladakh's most important monastery and the setting for the region's most celebrated annual festival.
places.bestTime: May to October; June-July for the Hemis Festival

places.name: Zanskar Valley
places.description: Ladakh's most remote and spectacular valley, offering world-class rafting and medieval cliff monasteries.
places.bestTime: June to October; January-February for Chadar trek

places.name: Tso Moriri Lake
places.description: India's highest Ramsar wetland, teeming with rare high-altitude wildlife in an utterly remote setting.

places.name: Stok Kangri Trek
places.description: The most accessible 6,000-metre summit in the Himalaya, offering a once-in-a-lifetime high-altitude achievement.

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
